product.title: Glacier Hike on Matanuska Glacier - Best Vacation Value
product.description: Explore the wilderness outside Anchorage with a local guide who knows where to spot wildlife and gain the best views throughout the year. Enter the Chugach National Forest to search for moose, bear, and other native wildlife. You will also visit Glacier Valley, home to several hanging glaciers and a lake of pure glacier water.
highlights: Small groups with a maximum of 12 guests
